recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Removing the remaining operations-page pointer would reduce navigability and conflict with later applied async decisions; future changes should be raised as a new FHIR-I decision about the current async.html/messaging.html content.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request against the DSTU1 operations page asking that the complex and under-documented "Executing an Operation Asynchronously" approach not remain in the ballot in its then-current form.
initial_application: FHIR-6336 has no commit explicitly naming it, but Jira comments and duplicate-family issue FHIR-7944 point to svn revision 5657. Git-svn commit 8b801ae887a7ed1c4e58cb57c30a8379b50cf157 is build@5657 and removed the detailed MTA/polling/tag instructions from source/operations.html while moving operation-via-message guidance to source/messaging.html.
additional_context: FHIR-7944 resolved the same old operations-page async section by moving it to messaging and referring from operations rather than adopting callback URLs. Related build@5657 issues FHIR-7976 and FHIR-6343 covered separate $process-message/mailbox details, and later final async issues FHIR-35936, FHIR-41202, and FHIR-47271 updated async.html, synchronicity conformance, and async pattern disambiguation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source no longer contains the old detailed operations-page asynchronous mechanism; source/operations.html has only a short pointer to source/async.html, source/async.html is the current canonical async pattern page for operations and interactions, and source/messaging.html retains operation invocation by messages in the messaging context.
